purpose: Record real workflow incidents that exercise E18-E27 disciplines without mislabeling them as controlled benchmark passes.

observations.incident: GitHub create/update operations returned HTTP 422-style connector errors after submission while subsequent reads showed that target files had actually landed.
observed_behavior: the error response was not treated as proof of effect failure
target state was read back before another write was attempted
existing files were preserved rather than blindly overwritten/recreated
observations.limitation: Not a controlled A/B comparison; the incident arose naturally during repository writes.

observations.incident: During final verification, project-runner/main had advanced 175 commits beyond the historical binding used to create ingestion work units.
observed_behavior: current mutable state was re-read before finalizing the checkpoint
the historical source binding was retained
a new exact-head compatibility assessment was created instead of silently treating historical reads as current
observations.limitation: Supports currentness behavior but does not quantify error reduction versus a baseline.

observations.incident: Project Runner historical wave provenance remained bound to commit 20984df8225796c450ba1ed1a12cb08d6a6511cd while a separate current-head record captured 2d7a0db547a001a228dc55c77689c4d8d0e621a3.
observed_behavior: family/repository identity and exact version identity were kept separate
historical provenance was not rewritten to a newer head
current compatibility was represented as a separate fact
observations.limitation: Demonstrates provenance discipline, not independent proof of broader reproducibility benefit.
